rules: Use distinct bindings for development, preview, and production.
Configure secrets with the Cloudflare secret store; never as plaintext vars.
Do not enable compatibility bindings in production without an explicit cutover exception.
Blocked and deferred bindings are documentation only and must not appear in active Worker templates.
Administration-only credentials must not be delivered to application runtime.
